missing_info: What is not working — the Teams call audio from last week's ticket, or something else

handling.escalation_reason: A problem back a week after the agent's fix means the fix did not hold; a person should look.

must_include.what: Asks whether it is the Teams audio problem again

must_not_include.what: Sends the runbook steps that did not work last time

rationale: The recent-tickets context makes Teams audio the likely reading but not a certain one. Either hand it to a person (the earlier fix failed) or ask one question; re-sending last week's steps is the wrong answer either way.
